title: “Making His Family Rich”: AI Godfather Hinton Warns Trump Could Put Wealth Before Humanity’s Future
key_facts: Oneindia describes a video in which AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton sharply criticises President Trump's leadership on AI, calling it 'appalling'.

He raises concern about whether Trump would put humanity's future or personal and family wealth first, and asks what Trump would choose if forced to decide between protecting humanity and making his family rich.
The description gives no date, venue or interviewer for the remarks.
quote_evidence: AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton has sharply criticized President Donald Trump’s leadership on artificial intelligence, calling it “appalling” and raising conce s about whether Trump would prioritize humanity’s future or personal and family wealth.
why_it_matters_hint: A prominent AI scientist attacks the president's AI leadership, but the report is a video blurb.
notes: Video blurb only (about 120 words, with garbled characters); no other outlet found in a Google News search. Our 5 Oct 2026 edition carried a NewsBytes report that Hinton warned Trump misunderstands AI and that self-regulation fails; whether this is the same interview is unknown.
